changelog:
google-maps-leads 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a skill for generating qualified B2B leads from Google Maps based on your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
- Supports detailed filtering (industry, location, size, email/website/phone must-haves) and search query optimization
- Automates lead extraction, scoring by quality signals, and CSV export
- Handles deduplication and prioritization (A/B/C tiers) of leads for effective outreach
- Integrates with cold email, competitor analysis, and CRM workflows 
- Enforces a credit-based search system, with a helpful onboarding and usage flow
summary: Generate qualified B2B leads from Google Maps. Define your ICP, extract matching businesses, score and qualify leads, export ready-to-outreach lists.
